schema_note: This document follows the wave10 function-handoff.v1 field set and adds five keys the wave10 shape did not need: the two decompilation_defects_corrected and unresolved_questions lists that carry the corrected evidence, observed_body.instruction_count_source, ghidra_provenance.binary_sha256 and implementation.boundary_test.
semantic_label: rig index pass: walk the rig block array from the caller owned index, resolve one property per live block and paint a unit parameter overlay on texture slot zero

abi.frame: PUSH EBP / MOV EBP,ESP / SUB ESP,0x40
abi.return_contract: MOV AL,CL at 0x0051a68c follows XOR ECX,ECX and SETGE CL, so only the low lane is written over the cursor; the model returns the widened boolean and the model test pins both the drained and the bounded cases

observed_body.instruction_count_source: the reviewed staging handoff for this address
instruction_list: read the system, the painter and the mesh, and take the rig block array from the mesh block at +0x98
start the render on texture slot zero
loop while the first cursor at +0x10 is below the rig block count and the pass count is below ten
skip a rig block whose flag half word at +0x08 has bit zero set and advance the cursor
read the slot entry quad at mesh + 0x90 plus the cursor and form the low and high pairs from its first two and last two floats
resolve the property 0x02424657 through 0x006a1250 and create a render target through the create vtable slot +0x1c with the block and the tag six when the property answers

when a target was made, set the colour write to (0,0,0,1), set the material to 0xa91b6551, store the unit parameter quad, prepare the slot, bind it as the first raster, clear the second raster, paint the pair and bump the pass count
advance the first cursor on every pass, whether or not a target was made
end the render and answer one when the cursor reached the rig block count

runtime_gates: the receiver class is unresolved; the target reads only the two cursor words of the opaque job state
all seven ports are dependency-only, so the property resolve and the target creation are unverified in this package
the create vtable slot +0x1c owner is unresolved and the prepare slot +0x34 owner is equally unresolved
the property key 0x02424657 and the create tag six are undecoded
decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation advances the cursor only after a successful create; the assembly increments it on every pass, so the corrected model advances unconditionally and the pass count only on success
the decompilation reports the answer as a full width compare; the assembly writes only CL after XOR ECX,ECX and SETGE CL, so the model returns the widened byte
the decompilation omits the clear of the second raster at +0x40 before the paint; the assembly stores a null there, so the corrected model keeps the clear

ghidra_provenance.evidence_rule: The disassembly listed in observed_body was read back from the live Ghidra database for SporeApp.exe at the addresses shown, and the byte extent, its length and its sha256 were computed from the .text section of SPORE/SporeBin/SporeApp.exe (.text VMA 0x00401000, file offset 0x400). The sha256 below covers exactly that byte extent; ghidra_provenance.binary_sha256 records the whole file. No Ghidra symbol, structure, comment or program state was created or modified.
